data:text/html,<body style=margin:0;overflow:hidden;background:%230d0f1e><div id=garden></div><div id=hint>move to morph - click to pluck</div><style>html,body{height:100%25}body{margin:0;background:%230d0f1e;overflow:hidden}%23garden{position:fixed;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;touch-action:none}%23hint{position:fixed;bottom:14px;width:100%25;text-align:center;color:%238f8ab8;font:13px monospace}.petal{position:absolute;width:110px;height:110px;border-radius:50%25;mix-blend-mode:screen;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50%25 0%25,%230a1030,%233a2a8f,%237aa2ff);--ang:90deg;--pos:150px;--big:1;transform:translate(calc(cos(var(--ang))*var(--pos)),calc(sin(var(--ang))*var(--pos)*-1)) scale(var(--big));animation:breathe 4s ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes breathe{from{--pos:150px;--big:1}to{--pos:100px;--big:2.6}}@property --pos{syntax:"<length>";initial-value:150px;inherits:true}@property --big{syntax:"<number>";initial-value:1;inherits:true}</style><script>let e=document.getElementById("garden"),t=[523,587,659,784,880,1047],n=0,o=null;for(let t=0;t<6;t++){let n=document.createElement("div");n.className="petal",n.style.setProperty("--ang",60*t+30+"deg"),e.appendChild(n)}let i=e.children;function l(e,t){for(let n of i)n.style.animation="none",n.style.setProperty("--pos",500*e+"px"),n.style.setProperty("--big",(10*t).toFixed(2))}onpointermove=e=>l(e.clientX/innerWidth,e.clientY/innerHeight),document.body.onmouseleave=function(){for(let e of i)e.style.animation="",e.style.removeProperty("--pos"),e.style.removeProperty("--big")},onpointerdown=e=>{o||(o=new AudioContext),l(e.clientX/innerWidth,e.clientY/innerHeight);let i=o.createOscillator(),r=o.createGain(),a=o.currentTime;i.type="triangle",i.frequency.value=t[n++%25t.length],i.connect(r),r.connect(o.destination),r.gain.setValueAtTime(.2,a),r.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,a+.9),i.start(a),i.stop(a+1)};</script>
